t: Shello laasot melaka beereb pesach achar chatzot
s: Shello laasot melaka beereb pesach achar chatzot ubo k"g seipim: bizman shebbet hammiqdash haya qayyam aseru chakamim lekol adam miyyisrael laasot melaka beereb pesach mechatzot hayyom ulemala, lepi shemmechatzot vaelak hu zeman haqrabat happesach, vekol adam shemmaqrib qorban bekol yemot hashshana oto hayyom hu yom tob shello middibrehem, veasur lo laasot melaka beoto hayyom keen yom tob, lepikak beereb pesach mechatzot vaelak shehu zeman haqrabat happesach lekol yisrael hare hu yom tob shellahem, veasur baasiyyat melaka ap lemi sheppatur mehaqrabat happesach, kegon sheddar bechutz laaretz, kevan shehu yom tob lerob yisrael hammaqribim bo pesach:

Veap leachar shecharab bet hammiqdash ubatal qorban pesach, ap al pi ken lo nitbattel issur asiyyat melaka, kevan shenneesar beminyan chakamim al kol yisrael, vekol dabar shenneesar beminyan chakamim al kol yisrael, ap sheachar kak nitbattel hattaam shebbiglalo asaruhu, ap al pi ken lo nitbattel haissur, ad shennitvaadu beminyan kamminyan harishon lehattiro beperush:

Ulepikak, haoseh melaka bizman hazzeh mechatzot vaelak — meshammetin oto, kedin haober al dibre chakamim, vegam eno roeh siman beraka meotah melaka leolam, shemmah shehu mistakker bimlaka zo yihyeh lo hepsed kenegdah bemaqom acher:

Veap im eno oseh kede lehistakker ella oseh bechinnam, ben leatzmo ben laacherim, apillu letzorek yom tob — hare zeh asur. Lepikak, asur lesapper leyisrael mechatzot vaelak, ap al pi sheoseh bechinnam umitkavven likbod yom tob. Vaapillu lesapper et atzmo asur. Abal muttar lehistapper al yede nokri. Ap al pi shehayyisrael matteh rosho elayv, vahare hu kimsayyea qetzat — en bekak kelum, shemmesayyea en bo mammash leinyan zeh:

Veken shear kol hammelakot nohagin lehattir laasot al yede nokri, apillu shello letzorek hammoed, shello ameru amira lenokri shebut, ella beshabbat veyom tob vechullo shel moed, abal ereb pesach achar chatzot — en bo qedushshat yom tob kelal, veqal hu yoter mechullo shel moed. Lepikak, kol mah shemmuttar laasot bechullo shel moed, kegon dabar haabed, o sheoseh maaseh hedyot velo maaseh umman veyesh bo tzorek hammoed, vekayyotze bahem mishshear debarim hammuttarim bechullo shel moed — kol shekken shemmuttarim beereb pesach achar chatzot. Veken kol otan shehittiru lesapper ulekabbes bechullo shel moed, kegon habba mimmedinat hayyam vehayyotze mibbet haasurim — muttarin gam ken beereb pesach achar chatzot:

Yesh oserin littol hatztzippornayim mechatzot vaelak. Veyesh meqillin, hoil veyesh mattirin apillu bechullo shel moed, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tql"b, ukeday hem lismok alehem al kol panim beereb pesach, shehu qal yoter mechullo shel moed. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla yesh lachosh lassebara harishona veyittelem qodem chatzot. Abal im shakach velo netalam qodem chatzot — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona, veyakol littelam achar chatzot:

Lo aseru beereb pesach ella melaka gemura, kegon laasot kelim chadashim, o litpor begadim chadashim. Abal rashshay hu letaqqen keli yashan shennitqalqel qetzat im yesh bo tzorek hammoed. Veken begadim shenniqreu qetzat — rashshay letopram uletaqqenan letzorek hammoed, apillu maaseh umman, ben leatzmo ben laacherim bechinnam. Abal besakar — asur apillu letzorek hammoed, apillu maaseh hedyot:

Liktob separim laacherim apillu bechinnam asur, shehakketiba hi melaka gemura, velo hittiruha apillu letzorek mitzva, ella im ken bederek shemmuttar bechullo shel moed. Abal muttar liktob separim leatzmo derek limmudo, dekevan shedderek limmudo uleatzmo hu koteb — eno niret kimlaka gemura, shebbevadday eno mitkavven liktiba gemura vahaguna, vahare dino ketiqqun beolma shehittiru letzorek hammoed, vehu haddin tzorek mitzvat ketibat dibre tora sheyyihyu lo lezikkaron:

Beereb pesach qodem chatzot taluy beminhag, maqom shennahagu laasot — osin kol hammelakot apillu shello letzorek hammoed. Ubemaqom shennahagu shello laasot — en osin. Veap benehem acharehem ad sop kol haddorot haddarim bair hazzot — enan rashshain leshannot mimminhag abotehen, mishshum shenneemar "veal tittosh torat immeka". Veap mi sheyyatza mimmaqom shennahagu laasot uba lagur bemaqom shennahagu shello laasot, im en dato lehachazir dirato leolam lammaqom sheyyatza mishsham, ella dato lehishtaqqea sham bammaqom shehalak lesham — hare hu naaseh miyyad keanshe oto maqom, vechalu alayv kol hachumrot shemmachamirin beoto maqom, veasur lo lehaqel apillu betzina, vaapillu chutz litchumah shel otah hair:

Umikkol maqom, kesheadayin lo higgia letok techumah shel otah hair — lo chalu alayv adayin chumre otah hair. Abal mishshehiggia letok techumah shel otah hair sheddato lehishtaqqea sham, ap sheachar kak halak mishsham lemaqom acher vedato lachazor leotah hair — lo nipqeu mimmennu chumroteha. Veim en dato lehishtaqqea leolam beotah hair, ella dato lachazor lammaqom sheyyatza mishsham, o lemaqom acher shennohagin bo hetter, apillu dato shello lachazor ad leachar zeman merubbeh, mikkol maqom, kevan sheen dato lehishtaqqea beotah hair leolam — lo chalu alayv chumre oto maqom, umuttar lo laasot melaka bassadeh chutz litchumah shel ir. Abal betok hattechum — asur leshannot minhagam, mippene hammachaloqet. Vaapillu rotzeh laasot betzina — asur, shei epshar limlaka lihyot kol kak betzina shello yivvada haddabar leshum adam:

Abal shear kol chumrot sheenan beissur melaka shemmachamirin beoto maqom shehalak lesham, im en dato lehishtaqqea sham — rashshay lehaqel bahen apillu betok hair, raq sheyyihyeh betzina, shello yivvada haddabar lahamon am veyabou lide machaloqet. Abal im yivvada haddabar letalmid chakam — en bekak kelum, shehattalmid chakam yodea shehaddabar taluy beminhag velo yabou lide machaloqet. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla en lo lehaqel bipne hattalmid chakam, ella sheim nahagu lehaqel betzina betok beto ubaemtza ba hattalmid chakam lebeto — en tzarik lehapsiq mippanayv, ella yakol ligmor haddabar shennoheg bo lehaqel bipne hattalmid chakam, dekevan shehitchil laasot betzina — lo yabo hattalmid chakam immo lide machaloqet, shehattalmid chakam yodea shemmuttar lo lehaqel betzina. Abal im adam acher sheeno talmid chakam ba letok beto — tzarik lehapsiq mippanayv, shello yivvada lo haddabar veyabo lide machaloqet:

Haholek mimmaqom shennohagim bo issur uba lemaqom shennohagin bo hetter vedato lehishtaqqea sham leolam, kevan shehiggia letok techumah shel otah hair sheddato lehishtaqqea bah — nipqeu mimmennu chumre hammaqom sheyyatza mishsham, umuttar lo laasot melaka apillu beparhesya:

Veim en dato lehishtaqqea sham leolam, ella dato lachazor limqomo o lemaqom acher shennohagin bo issur — notenin alayv chumre maqom sheyyatza mishsham, veasur lo laasot melaka ben betzina ben beparhesya. Veap al pi ken lo yitraeh bipne anshe oto maqom shehu batel mimmelaka mechamat issur keminhag meqomo, shello yabo lide machaloqet, ella yehe nidmeh beenehem shehu batel mechamat sheen lo melaka laasot:

Veken bishar kol chumrot shemmachamirin bammaqom sheyyatza mimmennu umeqillin bahem bammaqom shehalak lesham, sheap sheddato lachazor limqomo velo nipqeu mimmennu chumre hammaqom sheyyatza mishsham, ap al pi ken lo yitraeh bipnehem shehu machamir bemah shehem meqillin, shello yabou lide machaloqet, ella yachamir betzina, shello yivvada haddabar lahamon am. Veim hu beinyan shei epshar lo lehachamir ella im ken yivvada haddabar lahamon am — lo yachamir kelal, ella yinhag hetter kemotam, sheggadol hashshalom, veyesh lo laabor al minhag meqomo mippene hashshalom, kevan sheeno ober al issur shel tora (velo al dibre soperim) ella al minhag bilbad:

Vekol zeh keshebba leir sheyyesh bah minhag qabua lehaqel, abal im en bah minhag qabua lehaqel, ap sheen bah gam ken minhag qabua lehachamir, ap im dato lehishtaqqea bah leolam — lo nipqeu mimmennu chumre hammaqom sheyyatza mishsham, ad sheyyehe niqba bair minhag qabua lehaqel:

Apillu bemaqom shennahagu shello laasot — lo nahagu min hassetam ella mehanetz hachamma vaelak, abal qodem laken — muttar. Veim yesh maqom sheyyesh bo minhag qabua beberur leesor ap qodem hanetz hachamma — en zeh minhag chashub kelal, vekol mi shebba lesham mimmaqom acher ap sheddato lehishtaqqea sham — lo chala alayv chumra zo vekayyotze bah mechumrot sheen lahem minhag hagun, velo niqbeu bair al pi talmid chakam, ella haam hechemiru ken meatzmam. Umikkol maqom, tzarik lizzaher shello lehaqel bipne hamon am, shello yilmedu mimmennu lezalzel beissurin veyabou al yede ken lezalzel bishar issurin shehen asurin min haddin. Abal bipne talmid chakam — rashshay lehaqel. Abal hattalmid chakam atzmo kevan shehu meanshe otah hair — asur lo lehaqel apillu beno leben atzmo, dekevan shebbene hair yodeim sheddabar zeh muttar hu min haddin veap al pi ken nahagu lehachamir — hare chumra zo keneder al kol anshe hair, veenah nitteret ella bishela vacharata, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman ry"d:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beoto haddor atzmo shennahagu chumra zo, veken benehem acharehem shennahagu chumra zo shalosh peamim bechayye abotehem o leachar mitatam, o apillu lo nahagu ella paam achat ella shehaya bedatam az linhog ken leolam — hare naaset chumra zo alehem keneder. Abal im lo haya bedatam ken, velo nahagu ken shalosh peamim, ap al pi sheabotehem qibbeluha alehem beneder venahagu bah kol yemehem — en benehem chayyabim leqayyem minhag abotehem, kevan shehu minhag garua shello naasa al pi talmid chakam, ella shennahagu ken hehamon meatzmam, veen taam nakon leminhagam. Apillu bemaqom shennahagu shello laasot — lo nahagu min hassetam ella shello lehatchil melaka bey"d shacharit, abal kol melaka shehitchil bah qodem y"d — yakol legomrah bey"d ad chatzot im hi letzorek hammoed. Chutz mishshalosh ummaniyyot, shehen: hachayyatin, vehassapparin, vehakkobesin, shehen yekolim apillu lehatchil bitchilla bey"d shacharit im yekolim ligmor ad chatzot, kede sheyyukal lehanot mimmelakto bammoed. Velamma heqellu beshalosh ummaniyyot ellu? Lepi shemmatzinu sheheqellu bahen bechullo shel moed, shemmeleket hattepira hittiru lehedyot sheeno umman, shemmuttar lo litpor begadim bechullo shel moed, vehaggilluach vehakkibbus hittiru lemi shebba mimmedinat hayyam uleyotze mibbet haasurim bechullo shel moed, veyom zeh hu qal yoter mechullo shel moed, lepikak yesh lehattir hattepira apillu leumman, vehaggilluach vehakkibbus apillu lemi sheeno ba mimmedinat hayyam. Veod, sheshshalosh ummaniyyot ellu hen tzerikot el haam tzorek gadol likbod yom tob, lepikak heqellu bahen yoter mibbishar melakot sheenan tzerikin kol kak likbod yom tob:
Vekol zeh bemaqom shennahagu shello laasot, abal bemaqom shennahagu laasot — muttar lehatchil kol hammelakot ad chatzot ap al pi sheen bahen tzorek hammoed kelal:

Moshibin shobakin leyonim kol hayyom. Veken letaqqen maqom sheyyaamdu sham hattarnegolim vehattarnegolot — muttar kol hayyom, apillu leachar chatzot. Abal asur lehoshib hattarnegolet al habbetzim bitchilla bey"d achar chatzot kede legaddel eprochim, o qodem chatzot bemaqom shennahagu shello laasot. Abal im yoshba kebar al habbetzim shelosha yamim o yoter umeta — muttar lehoshib acheret tachteha bey"d apillu achar chatzot, lepi shehu dabar haabed, sheim lo yoshib tarnegolet al habbetzim — shub enan reuyim liklum, shekkebar nipselu meakilat adam keshennitchammemu tachat hattarnegolet shelosha yamim, ayyen siman tql"v:

Gorepin zebel mittachat ragle habbehema bey"d kol hayyom umashlikin oto chutz larepet, apillu harepet gedola vehazzebel meat veyakol lesalleq litzdadin betok harepet, ap al pi ken rashshay lehotziah chutz larepet, mippene sheharepet nivvulah qasheh apillu en sham ella meat zebel. Abal hazzebel shebbechatzer — lo yotzienna lachutz im en sham ella meat zebel sheyyakol lesalleqo litzdadim, shehechatzer en nivvulah qasheh kol kak kesheen bah ella meat zebel mesullaq litzdadeha. Abal im nitrabba hazzebel bechatzer (kol kak ad shennaaset hechatzer kerepet) — muttar lo lehotzi hazzebel laashpa lachutz lirshut harabbim:

Muttar leholik kelim lebet haumman bey"d kol hayyom ap al pi shello yetaqqenem ad leachar hammoed. Veken muttar lehabi kelim mibbet haumman ap al pi sheen bahem tzorek hammoed kelal. Ayyen siman tql"d:

Nahagu kol yisrael shello lehaqqiz dam beshum ereb yom tob, veen leshannot. Lepi shebbeyom shabuot qodem mattan tora yatza ruach sheshshemo "teboach", sheim lo yeqabbelu yisrael et hattora haya tobeach ledamam ubesaram, lepikak yesh sakkana ledorot lehaqqiz dam beoto yom, dehaynu beereb shabuot. Vegazeru chakamim al kol ereb yom tob mishshum ereb shabuot. Umikkol maqom, beereb yom tob haacharon shel pesach — muttar lehaqqiz, shehakkol regel echad hu veeno ereb yom tob ella emtza yamim tobim. Abal beereb yom tob haacharon shel chag, dehaynu behoshana rabba — asur lehaqqiz, shehu ereb yom tob mammash, sheshshemini atzeret regel bipne atzmo leinyan kamma debarim. Ubelel ereb yom tob — muttar lehaqqiz, chutz millel hoshana rabba, shehu lel din:

Haqqaza sheqqorin qa"p zatzy"n, kevan sheeno domeh lehaqqazat dam mammash — yesh lehattir beereb pesach ubeereb sukkot, sheen issuran ella mishshum gezera beolma. Abal beereb shabuot sheissuro mishshum sakkana — yesh lizzaher. Veken behoshana rabba, shehu yom din:
